import json, os, subprocess, sys, hashlib
from pathlib import Path

repo=Path("/Users/steventran/do-again")
expected_head="b5c09ec117b4cc9a3cb752ad248631a32a0b08eb"
head=subprocess.run(["git","rev-parse","HEAD"],cwd=repo,text=True,capture_output=True).stdout.strip()
if head!=expected_head:
    raise SystemExit(f"main moved before preflight: {head}")

sys.path.insert(0,str(repo/"src"))
from do_again.service.rollout import _tree_hash

key=hashlib.sha256(str(repo.resolve()).encode()).hexdigest()[:12]
root=Path.home()/".do_again/projects"/key
env=os.environ.copy()
env["PYTHONPATH"]=str(repo/"src")

p=subprocess.run(
    ["python3","-m","do_again.cli","upgrade",str(repo)],
    cwd=repo,text=True,capture_output=True,check=False,env=env
)

print(json.dumps({
  "repo_head":head,
  "source_hash":_tree_hash(repo/"src/do_again"),
  "runtime_hash":_tree_hash(root/"runtime/do_again"),
  "dry_run":{"rc":p.returncode,"stdout":p.stdout,"stderr":p.stderr},
},indent=2,sort_keys=True))
print("SELF_CLEAN_NEW_MAIN_UPGRADE_PREFLIGHT_OK")
